review.summary: Independent cross-review split the original aggregate buckets, verified all 91 journeys against source/spec authority, and drove corrections until the project/Space, inventory/billing, action-modal, shared-control, and media batches each returned GO. The final catalog contains 167 unique covered surface IDs, 0 uncovered IDs, 299 control groups, 928 named options, 294 transitions, and 398 visible or edge states.

scopeReview.note: Signed-in Account discovery/selection entry; target authorization realization may differ.

outcomes.title: Discover authorized Accounts
outcomes.outcome: Show environment/Principal-bound Account IDs and safe names in deterministic order, allowing equal names but rejecting duplicate IDs. Preserve version/time/readiness and distinguish complete zero membership from loading, partial, stale and failed discovery.

scopeReview.note: Explicit Account entry exists; preserve isolation, not old service structure.

outcomes.title: Select an Account workspace explicitly
outcomes.outcome: Require explicit selection even for one Account. Produce a local intent only for an ID in the exact displayed snapshot; reject changed or rebound evidence. Activation separately enforces authorization, and MCP uses bounded request/session context.

companionAuthorityRefs.heading: Target Online Entry and Account Onboarding

scopeReview.note: Target authorization requirement: preference is not permission to activate cached data. Not an identical source-behavior claim.

outcomes.title: Remember workspace preference without automatic activation
outcomes.outcome: Remember the last Account only within the same environment and Principal. If still visible it may sort first, but it never becomes automatically selected or grants access; ignore a missing remembered ID without disclosure.

scopeReview.note: Security invariant of the authorized Account-selection workflow.

outcomes.title: Fail workspace selection without disclosure
outcomes.outcome: Use bounded non-enumerating failures. If cached discovery is retained on failure, label it stale or partial. Reject malformed or rebound evidence and expose no credentials, provider paths, financial values or hidden membership details.

scopeReview.note: Safe replacement of reachable sign-out under user-required offline durability; open rejection policy remains blocked.

outcomes.title: Resolve rejected work before ordinary logout
outcomes.outcome: Preserve unresolved rejected operations across restart and ordinary logout. Implement a retry or acknowledgment only after O-051 settles responsibility transfer; closing review never resolves or deletes accepted work.

Duplicate names are valid. Media reconciles separately; expose accepted/pending/rejected state, never silent partial setup.

Active's Inventory card opens Account-scoped Items/Transactions/Spaces with remembered section and shared child workflows, never a fake Project. Budget preview and planning remain separate.

executionRecords.title: Return an uninvoiced Item to Inventory
executionRecords.outcome: Return the Item to Inventory, remove its uninvoiced positive charge and unpaid Furnishings progress, and link the return to the reversed sale occurrence. Retain audit history; create no Invoice, credit or project Transaction.

uiJourneys.sourcePage: FormSheet and existing receipt capture controls

controls.label: Vendor / Date / Amount / Category / Notes
controls.action: Enter the Expense fields and choose a downloaded eligible category.
controls.result: Validation preserves exact money and selected scope; no client payment is created.

controls.label: Add receipt line
controls.action: Add description, line total, Increase or Decrease and optional quantity; Remove line removes that draft line.
controls.result: Receipt detail does not change the Expense amount or create physical Items.

controls.label: Add receipt
controls.action: Use existing receipt capture/import; Remove selection deselects a receipt.
controls.result: Durable receipt references survive retry; deselection does not silently destroy stored evidence.

controls.label: Save / Retry save
controls.action: Submit valid fields once; retry a failed attempt with its frozen identity and contents.
controls.result: Accepted Expense is durable; incomplete recovery, missing category or active save/import disables submission.

controls.label: Cancel / Save for later / Close
controls.action: Dismiss an empty draft or retain a recoverable entry with captured files; close an attempted save without rewriting it.
controls.result: No accidental payment or duplicate Expense; pending files/work are retained.

controls.label: Retry receipt recovery
controls.action: Retry unavailable saved receipt bytes.
controls.result: Failure retains references and blocks submission; success restores the draft.

states.expected: Form and submission action unavailable; pending work retained.
